findings.summary: Seed calls drizzle db.insert directly, bypassing module repo layer (insertUser).
findings.suggested_fix: Import insertUser from apps/api/src/modules/auth/repo.ts and call it once per user instead of building the insert inline; preserves §2.3 'repo.ts is the only db-touching file' for the auth module.

findings.summary: SEED_PASSWORD default literal hardcoded in source (also in .env.example).
findings.suggested_fix: Acceptable for PoC seed but consider removing the default and failing fast when SEED_PASSWORD is unset in non-dev environments; or guard with NODE_ENV check.

findings.summary: insertSeedUsers emails differ from production seed (seed.test vs medbridge.test) — silent drift risk.
findings.suggested_fix: Either reuse PATIENT_EMAIL/DOCTOR_EMAIL constants from a shared module or document the deliberate split in a top-of-file comment so future readers do not assume parity.

findings.summary: withReuse() left enabled outside CI may surface stale schema between local runs after migration changes.
findings.suggested_fix: Document that contributors must run `docker rm` on the reused container when migrations change; or invalidate reuse via container name including a migrations-folder hash.
